name: zeb/potoru
description: Potoru 2D animation for RWE templates. A .poto player (canvas renderer, play / slide / interactive modes, host bridge set / fire / report) and an in-browser compiler from Potoru format v4 source folders (plus an experimental sandboxed authoring-API script mode). The entry bundle is a small bridge; the player and the compiler load on demand from files next to it. Fully offline.

source.package: @potoru/player + @potoru/authoring (built from Potoru sources; not on npm yet)
